hooks.name: ClimateTwin data integrity review
hooks.description: Review critical data-pipeline changes for leakage and provenance problems.

action.prompt: Review the just-saved ClimateTwin data-pipeline file for scientific correctness. Review only; do not modify files in this hook. Check chronological train/validation/test ordering, no split overlap, train-only fitting of learned preprocessing, missing-value leakage, sequence input/target alignment, split-boundary leakage, stable feature/target ordering, station-safe multi-location sequences, sampling-interval validation, units, provenance, and inverse-transform compatibility. If the file affects pretraining data, also check target-location/test-period isolation. Report specific issues; if none are found, say that the review passed.

hooks.name: ClimateTwin experiment integrity review
hooks.description: Review model, training, evaluation, rollout, and scenario changes for research validity.

action.prompt: Review the just-saved ClimateTwin experiment-related file. Review only; do not modify files in this hook. Check output/target schema consistency, reproducibility/seed handling, fair scratch-vs-transfer comparison, checkpoint/config compatibility, documented scaler policy, original-unit per-variable MAE/RMSE, no mixed-unit physical aggregate metric, explicit autoregressive feature updates, no future-ground-truth leakage, required horizons 1/3/6/12/24 where applicable, ACC only with a justified climatology, non-causal scenario wording, and no fabricated or placeholder results. Report concrete issues or state that the review passed.
